title: Moto Phase 5 — set design dossier and background plates (moto-locations-v4)
description: One answer of Phase 5 for a custom motorcycle film: the places the approved script uses, each with the one design of its set — architecture, materials, objects and where they stand — its zones and access routes; how the places connect; and the background plates, each a use of one place: a camera, a lighting plan, the state of the set and the conditions of the use. Every fact is stated once: a place states what never changes, a plate states only how it is used and what differs. The motorcycle, its parts, mockups, drawings and people are added at the shot step. null means not known or not applicable as the field defines; [] means none; 0 is a real value and never stands for unknown.

zone_id.description: A zone of one place, numbered Z01… inside that place.

route_id.description: An access route of one place, numbered R01… inside that place.

architecture_id.description: A part of the architecture of one place, numbered AR01… inside that place.

object_id.description: An object of the set of one place, numbered OB01… inside that place.

light_id.description: A light source of one plate, numbered LS01… inside that plate.

set_ref.description: A part of the architecture or an object of the place the plate stands on. Ids are unique inside one place only: a plate never refers to another place.

place_ref.description: A zone, a part of the architecture or an object of the place the plate stands on.

dimension.description: A measurement in metres with where it comes from: source when the input states it, production_assumption when you chose it, unknown when nothing settles it. An approved assumption never becomes a surveyed measurement.

quote.description: Words copied character for character from one field of one beat of the input.

footprint.description: The rectangle something covers on the floor in the place's coordinate system, its sides along the axes: x_m and y_m are its corner nearest the origin, size_x_m and size_y_m its extent along each axis, all in metres.

point.description: A point on the floor in the place's coordinate system, in metres.

zone.description: One area of a place with one use: where the subject stands, where people work, where parts wait, where the vehicle or people pass, where a camera can stand, or what cannot be used.

position.description: Where the zone lies, told by the architecture, the objects and the zones beside it. A camera zone also says which way a camera there looks and how near it comes.

footprint.description: null when the place has no coordinate system or nothing settles the numbers: the position then stands alone and the fit is not verified.

subject_axis.description: For a subject zone: the axis the length of the subject lies along; null when it is not settled or the zone holds no subject.

access_route.description: A door, opening, road or path by which people, parts or the vehicle reach a zone of the place.

leads_to.description: What lies on the other side: outside, another room, the road.

zone.description: The zone of this place the route opens into; null when it opens into none of the zones listed.

architecture.description: One part of the architecture that matters to the picture: a floor, a wall, a ceiling or roof, a door, a window, the edge of a yard, a quay. An open place lists only what it has.

description.description: What it is and its shape, in one sentence; no light, no mood.

position.description: Where it lies in the place: the side by the coordinate axes, or beside which other part.

colour.description: Its own colour in neutral light, in plain words. The light of a plate changes how it looks, never this colour.

surface.description: A property of the surface the picture must show — reflective, wet sheen, dusty, oil-stained; null when nothing more than the finish.

landmark.description: true when it tells one direction of the place from another and two views must be able to show it.

object.description: One thing of the set that bears on the picture, the action or continuity: a machine, a bench, a table, a tool, a prop, something that holds the subject. Its position, facing, presence and condition here are the base state of the place; a plate changes them only through its set_state. Never the motorcycle, its parts, a mockup, a drawing of it or a person.

purpose.description: What it is for in this place.

role.description: equipment the place works with; prop set dressing; support what holds or carries the subject; landmark what tells one direction of the place from another.

support_kind.description: For a support that is one of the temporary items the input lists (temporary_equipment): that item, copied exactly; null for every other object.

fixed.description: true when it never moves; false when a plate may move, turn, add or remove it.

zone.description: The zone of this place it stands in; null when it stands in none of the zones listed.

position.description: Where it stands, told by the architecture, the zones and the objects beside it.

footprint.description: The floor it covers, when the place has a coordinate system and the fit must be checked by numbers; otherwise null.

facing.description: Which way it faces or runs; null when it has no direction.

identity.description: What makes it recognisable from another view; null when nothing beyond its name and material.

present.description: Whether it stands in the place in its base state. An object only some plates show is listed here with false and added by their set_state.

condition.description: Its state of use in the base state — idle, covered, in use, tidy; null when nothing to say.

set_design.description: The one design of the set of a place: the source for its architecture, surfaces and objects. Nothing here is repeated in another field.

identity_rules.description: What makes every view recognisable as this same place: each a concrete thing to keep, never a mood.

location.description: What a place is and keeps in every use. What changes from one use to another belongs to the plates.

function.description: What this place does for the story, in one sentence.

source_beats.description: Every beat that uses the place, in script order.

provenance.description: fictional_set for an invented place, however real it looks; real_place only for an existing place the input supplies a source for, named in source.

space.description: What kind of place it is and how it is laid out, in one sentence. No material, object or light: those are stated in set_design and in the plates.

coordinate_system.description: The local floor plan the footprints and points are measured in, in metres: origin is the floor corner or point it starts from, x_axis and y_axis what each axis runs along. x covers the length of the place and y its width. null when the place has no numbered plan, as an open road has none.

camera_access.description: The clear space a camera can travel through around the subject zone, and what blocks it.

connection.description: How two places stand to each other. basis script quotes the beat that says so; basis assumption is your choice and has no evidence.

route.description: The way from one to the other, when the story needs it; null when the film only cuts.

camera.description: The camera of the still frame of a plate: the one statement of where it stands and what it looks at. Never a camera move.

zone.description: The camera zone of the place it stands in; null when it stands in none of the zones listed.

position.description: Where it stands, told by the architecture, the zones and the objects.

point.description: Its point on the floor plan, when the place has a coordinate system and you place it by numbers; null when not placed by numbers. Never 0 for unknown.

height_m.description: Its height above the floor in metres; null when not chosen.

ref.description: The zone, part of the architecture or object it looks at; null when it looks at none of them.

description.description: Which way it looks, in words.

lens_mm.description: The focal length in millimetres for a full-frame sensor; null when not chosen.

framing.description: What of the place the frame must show and the clear space it leaves for the subjects.

light_source.description: One light that shapes the frame. A fixture the frame shows is named in fixture; a production light outside the frame never appears as a lamp or a softbox in the picture.

position.description: Where the light comes from, told by the place.

direction.description: The direction it falls in, as the frame sees it.

intensity.description: Its strength against the other sources of this plate.

kelvin.description: The colour temperature only when a source states it; otherwise null. Never invented.

in_frame.description: true when the frame shows the fixture itself.

fixture.description: The part of the architecture or the object the light comes from — a window, a ceiling panel, a lamp; required when in_frame is true; null for a production light with no fixture in the place.

area.description: Which part of the frame or of the place.

purpose.description: What it does for the composition. It describes what the light does; it adds no object.

lighting_plan.description: The light of a plate: its sources and where the frame is bright and dark. evidence quotes the beat when the script states the light; otherwise reason says why you chose it.

subject_exposure.description: How the subject zone stands against the rest of the frame; null for a frame that holds no subject.

state_change.description: One difference of this plate from the base state of the place. In present, position, facing and condition, null means unchanged: the base state holds. Only an object that is not fixed is added, removed, moved or turned; a part of the architecture changes only its condition.

present.description: true adds an object the base state does not show, false removes one it shows; null leaves it as it is.

position.description: Its new position; null when it stays.

facing.description: Its new facing; null when it stays.

condition.description: Its state of use, cleanliness or surface in this plate; null when unchanged.

beats.description: The beats of the plate that call for the change.

set_state.description: The state the set is in for this plate: its name and only what differs from the base state of the place. changes is [] when nothing differs. Never the build state of the motorcycle.

background.description: One plate: an empty still frame of a place in one use. A use that changes the picture — another camera, time of day, weather, ground or state of the set — has a plate of its own.

composition.description: What the frame is for and its layers of depth — what stands in front of, around and behind the subject zone. No camera position, height or lens: those are stated in camera.

subject_zone.description: The subject zone of the place the frame leaves empty for the subjects; null for a frame that holds no subject.

visible.description: The parts of the architecture and the objects of the place this frame shows.

weather.description: The weather the frame shows, for an exterior or an interior that looks out or is touched by it; null when it does not bear on the picture.

atmosphere.description: What is seen in the air or on surfaces — dust in a beam, haze, mist, reflections — only when the use calls for it; otherwise null.

ground.description: dry or wet when a use states its road surface; otherwise null.

ambient_sound.description: The steady sound of the place under these conditions, handed to the video step; never part of the still image. null when nothing is heard.

avoid.description: Things that must not appear, each named as a thing: a noun phrase, never a sentence that begins with no or do not.

continuity.description: What plates of one place must keep and what may differ between them. Plates of one place always keep the place; same_layout says they also keep where every object stands; same_camera says they are the same frame. may_change lists what is allowed to differ; anything not listed stays.
